context.passage:
To: | [Greta Myers <gmyers @wingstar.com.bm> |
From: | Maurice [ Tolliver <mtolliver@bermudasciencemuseum.bm> ‘|
Date: | | 25 June |
Subject: | | Membership campaign |
Attachment:| | survey
Dear Ms. Myers:
The Bermuda Science Museum’s September membership campaign will soon begin. In
order to serve our present members the best way we can and attract new members, we are
asking for your feedback. We are interested in how we can best meet your needs and
expectations and would like to know how you feel about the permanent and special
museum exhibitions, our newly renovated cafés, and the parking area.
Perhaps you were one of the many visitors who enjoyed our special seafaring exhibition in
April. Do you think any part of your experience visiting the replica of the
eighteenth-century ship, the Betsy, could have been better?
Please help us improve our museum and its programs by completing the attached survey.
Thank you, and I look forward to seeing you again at the museum.
Maurice Tolliver
Director of Museum Services
(http://www.bermudasciencemuseum.com _ ;

context.passage_translation:
收件人: | [Greta Myers <gmyers @wingstar.com.bm> |
发件人: | Maurice [ Tolliver <mtolliver@bermudasciencemuseum.bm> ‘|
日期: | | 6 月 25 日 |
主题: | | 会员活动宣传 |
附件:| | survey (调查问卷)
尊敬的迈尔斯女士：
百慕大科学博物馆的九月会员活动即将开始。为了以最好的方式服务我们现有的会员并吸引新会员，我们征求您的反馈意见。我们有兴趣了解如何最好地满足您的需求和期望，并想知道您对永久性和特别展览、我们新装修的咖啡馆以及停车区域的看法。
也许您曾是四月期间欣赏我们关于航海的特别展览的众多参观者之一。您认为游览十八世纪船只“贝茜号”（Betsy）复制品的经历中，哪个部分可以做得更好呢？
请通过填写附件中的调查问卷帮助我们改进博物馆及其项目。
谢谢，我期待在博物馆再次见到您。
莫里斯·托利弗 (Maurice Tolliver)
博物馆服务总监
(http://www.bermudasciencemuseum.com _ ;
百慕大科学博物馆
(感谢您参与我们的调查。请选择最能描述您在百慕大科学博物馆体验的回答。

| 咖啡馆 x
礼品店 xX
| 停车场 Xx
| 其他评论：
我一直很喜欢特别展览。沿着“贝茜号”散步太有趣了！我计划很快再回博物馆一次。
